MORNING_PANIC_DIP: The stock price must be between $1.00 and $10.00 at the time of the dip's onset. An 'initial anemic trading period' of at least 120 consecutive minutes must immediately precede the dip, starting within the first 60 minutes of market open. During this period, the average 1-minute volume must be a maximum of 0.00000001% of the average daily volume of the preceding 5 trading days, AND a maximum of 5 shares. The average 1-minute price range must be less than 0.0000005% of the stock's price, and no single trade can exceed 1 share. A brutal, rapid, and unequivocal price decline (the 'Panic') of at least 75% must occur from the high of the anemic period within a maximum of 3 consecutive 1-minute periods. The average 1-minute volume during this decline phase (from the high preceding the drop to the lowest point) must be at least 50000x the average 1-minute volume of the preceding initial anemic trading period. The absolute lowest 1-minute candle of this decline must establish the lowest price of the entire day thus far, exhibit the highest volume of the preceding 480 minutes, with its volume being at least 10000x the average 1-minute volume of the 10 minutes immediately preceding the decline, AND a minimum of 300% of the average daily volume of the preceding 5 trading days, AND a minimum of 100,000,000 shares. This specific low candle must close strictly within the upper 99.99999% of its own range, indicating overwhelming, instantaneous demand absorption at the absolute low. Time & Sales data for this precise candle must show >99.999% aggressive market buy orders with an average trade size of at least 1,000,000 shares, and aggressive sell orders impacting the bid representing less than 0.00000001% of total aggressive buy volume. Immediately following this low candle, an unequivocal, powerful, and sustained reversal must ensue. Within the next 15 minutes, the price must reclaim at least 99% of the total price decline (from the dip high to the dip low), with cumulative volume during this 15-minute reversal exceeding 3000% of the entire dip's volume (from high to low), AND a minimum of 500% of the average daily volume of the preceding 5 trading days, AND a minimum of 150,000,000 shares. A maximum of 0 red candles is permitted within these 15 minutes (all must be green). Each green candle during this phase must close in the upper 99.999% of its range and have a volume at least 2000x its average volume of the preceding 5 minutes of the dip. The average 1-minute volume over these 15 reversal minutes must be at least 50000x higher than the average 1-minute volume of the initial anemic trading period, and also at least 5000x the average 1-minute volume of the entire dip phase. Price must decisively reclaim its pre-dip VWAP level (VWAP calculated from market open up to the start of the panic dip) and close at least 10% above it. The 1-minute candle that breaches VWAP must have a volume at least 100000x the average volume of the initial anemic trading period and must trade at least 300% of the average daily volume of the preceding 5 trading days, AND a minimum of 150,000,000 shares, with its close in the upper 99.99999% of its range. This breakout must be sustained for a minimum of 480 consecutive minutes. During these 480 minutes: every 1-minute candle must close above the pre-dip VWAP; no single 1-minute candle's low can pierce or even touch the pre-dip VWAP; cumulative net aggressive market buy orders (via time & sales data) must account for >99.999% of total shares traded, with average trade size > 1,000,000 shares; the price must continue to appreciate or consolidate within an extremely tight 0.00000001% range; any 1-minute candle showing a closing price decrease must have its volume less than 0.00000001% of the average volume of the preceding 10 green candles AND its absolute volume must be less than 10 shares. The average 1-minute volume during this 480-minute sustained period above VWAP must be at least 50000x the average 1-minute volume of the initial anemic trading period. Furthermore, the cumulative volume during this 480-minute sustained period must exceed 50000% of the entire dip's volume (from the high preceding the dip to the lowest point), must be at least 3000% of the average daily volume of the preceding 5 trading days, AND a minimum of 1,000,000,000 shares. The highest price reached during this 480-minute sustained period must be at least 2000% above the lowest point of the dip.
MID_DAY_BREAKOUT: The stock price must be between $1.00 and $10.00 at the time of the breakout. A minimum of 480 consecutive minutes (8 hours) of extreme price consolidation must occur, starting at least 180 minutes after market open and concluding before the final 60 minutes of market close, where price remains strictly within a 0.005% range of its midpoint. The total consolidation range (high to low) must be less than $0.0005 for stocks below $3.00, and less than 0.005% of the stock's price for stocks $3.00 and above. Volume must exhibit an undeniable, drastic, and precisely progressive decrease throughout this consolidation, with a clear and continuous decrease towards absolute minimal levels, such that the final 120 minutes of consolidation show an average 1-minute volume no more than 0.0000000001% of the average daily volume of the preceding 5 trading days, AND a maximum of 1 share per minute. No single 1-minute candle during the final 360 minutes of consolidation can exceed 5 shares. The average 1-minute volume during the entire consolidation phase must be less than 0.000000001% of the average 1-minute volume of the 180 minutes immediately preceding the consolidation, which itself must show an average 1-minute volume at least 50000x greater than the consolidation average. The breakout must occur with an unparalleled, explosive, and instantaneous surge in volume. The 1-minute breakout candle's volume must be at least 200,000x the average 1-minute volume of the preceding 180 minutes of consolidation and must trade at least 400% of the average daily volume of the preceding 5 trading days, AND a minimum of 150,000,000 shares. This breakout candle must close at least 25% above the consolidation high, and its entire range (high to low) must be strictly above the consolidation high, with its low not piercing or even touching the consolidation resistance. The close of this candle must be within the upper 99.99999% of its own range. Time & Sales data for this precise breakout minute must show an overwhelming dominance of aggressive market buy orders, with >99.999% of total shares traded initiated on the ask, and the average trade size must be at least 1,000,000 shares, with aggressive sell orders impacting the bid representing less than 0.00000001% of total aggressive buy volume. Following the breakout candle, the next 480 consecutive 1-minute candles must all close strictly above the consolidation high. During this 480-minute period: each 1-minute candle must close higher than its open or consolidate within an extraordinarily tight 0.000000001% range of its open; no single 1-minute candle can ever retest or touch the prior consolidation high; the average 1-minute volume must remain at least 100,000x the average 1-minute volume of the entire consolidation phase; the cumulative volume over these 480 minutes must exceed 100,000% of the breakout candle's volume and must be at least 5000% of the average daily volume of the preceding 5 trading days, AND a minimum of 2,000,000,000 shares; the price must continue a clear upward trend or consolidate at the new elevated levels within a 0.000000001% range, with cumulative aggressive sell volume during this period being less than 0.00000001% of cumulative aggressive buy volume, and no single 1-minute candle can exhibit net aggressive sell volume exceeding 0.00000001% of its total volume, AND its absolute volume must be less than 10 shares. The highest price reached during this sustained period must be at least 300% above the breakout candle's close, AND at least 1000% above the consolidation high.
